title: Part 2: Light Cornered by a Shinigami's Death Threat

series.summary: L subjects Misa to brutal confinement to extract Kira's identity, driving Rem to wipe Misa's memories and threaten Light with death if he fails to save her.

cuts.voiceover_text: L has cornered the Second Kira with irrefutable physical evidence. Microscopic hairs and matching tape fibers retrieved from the envelopes prove Misa Amane's guilt beyond any shadow of a doubt. Light Yagami is gripped by sudden panic and disbelief. His carefully calculated plan is crumbling fast. He realizes his fatal blunder. He should have destroyed the incriminating television broadcast tapes before the task force raided her apartment. The suffocating psychological pressure mounts as L tightens the net. But despair quickly transforms into ruthless defiance. Light glares forward with venomous determination. He refuses to break. He vows that the true psychological war against L has only just begun.

Behind heavily fortified steel doors, L initiates extreme sensory deprivation against his captive. Misa is strapped into a dark confinement chair with a thick blindfold and heavy mechanical restraints. L refuses to show mercy until she surrenders a full confession. He demands to know her exact method of killing and Kira's true identity. The atmosphere in the command center turns chillingly grim. L looks directly at Chief Detective Yagami and drops a shattering bombshell. Light has officially become the primary suspect in the investigation. L declares he will arrest and interrogate Light next. The detective freezes in horror as the suspicion falls directly upon his own son.

Three agonizing days of sensory deprivation shatter Misa's physical and mental endurance. Bound in darkness, she weeps in sheer despair. She screams into the empty room and begs her captors to kill her. She knows that breaking under torture would expose Light Yagami. She refuses to betray the man she loves. In frantic panic, Misa attempts to bite off her tongue to commit suicide. Alarms wail across the facility as guards sprint to pry her jaws apart.

To rescue Misa from endless torture, the Shinigami Rem executes an irreversible sacrifice. Rem forces Misa to forfeit ownership of the Death Note. The forfeiture erases every memory of the killings, the notebook, and Kira, sparing her sanity while preserving her pure devotion to Light. Rem then materializes inside Light's private room. Light breathes a sigh of immense relief, believing Misa's memory loss secures his secret forever. But that fleeting relief turns to cold horror. Rem delivers a deadly ultimatum. If Light fails to save Misa from execution, Rem will slaughter him immediately.
